# UnifiedNeuralRepresentation

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A single mathematical framework that integrates both magnitude and phase aspects of neural activity into one coherent model for learning and inference. Reduces architectural complexity and improves learning efficiency in neuromorphic systems, supporting more robust in-network cognitive processing.
